text:
jordan.m: Alert — customers are seeing 'echoed' tokens in streaming chat (hosted, us-central). Started ~14:02 UTC. Sync endpoints fine. Opening incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3276543210

sre-raja: Confirmed in traces: identical chunk payloads with same seq_id emitted twice during proxy reconnects. Suspect client retry + mux replay race.

lizzy.p: Repro locally by forcing proxy reset during stream; downstream client retry causes duplicate emission. Adding eng-runtime and proxy owners.

ingress-bot: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) set streaming retry to fail-fast at proxy, 2) enable short window (6s) dedupe at ingress mux. Recommend canary 5%.

sre-raja: Rolling canary 5% for fail-fast + mux dedupe. Deploy started.

jordan.m: Canary telemetry after 6m: duplication rate from ~2.5x -> ~1.05x. No latency regressions. Proceeding to 25%.

sre-raja: Rolled to 100% at 3276543258. Post-mitigation metrics: duplication within noise. No further customer escalations.

cs-sam: Notifying affected customers and flagging orgs for follow-up credits if needed.

lizzy.p: Owners for RCA: eng-runtime (lizzy.p) to remove redundant replay path; eng-proxy (sre-raja) to clarify retry semantics. Postmortem in 72h.

status-page-bot: Public update posted: "Investigating — some hosted streaming responses in us-central may produce repeated tokens. Mitigations deployed; monitoring ongoing." (https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3276543210)

jordan.m: Keeping incident open for 30m of monitoring. If anything regresses, page oncall. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
